d:
Mokama ke purv vidhayak aur bahubli neta anant sinh (chhote sarkar) ki beti shivangi sinh ki shadi aagami 25 navanbar ko unke paitrik ganv nadvan/ladma (barh) men aayojit hone ja rahi hai. is shadi samaroh ko bihar ke itihas ki sabse bhavy aur shahi shadiyon men se ek banane ki taiyari behad jor-shor se chal rahi hai, jahan lagbhag 3 se 4 lakh logon ke jutne ka anuman hai.
Yupi ke maoo se pahunche 50 karigar, 100 phit ka simented stej
